    Indecomposability of orbit push-down #

    The invariant-summand argument implies that an orbit push-down is indecomposable when the upstairs module has local endomorphism ring and trivial translate stabilizer. Localness passes to every translate by precomposition with the shift autoequivalences, while trivial stabilizer makes the translates pairwise nonisomorphic.

    ¬Nonempty (orbitPullupPushdownTranslate M b ≅ orbitPullupPushdownTranslate M c)

    Trivial translate stabilizer makes the full family of translates pairwise nonisomorphic.
